title: Quartic twist index calculus with endomorphism-sum image factors and unchanged log columns
status_note: The 189-case panel, 21 doubling controls, 210 independent set/rank/recovery audits, 105 admitted complete cold rounds and 630 non-timing replays are complete. The same-input GB comparison has 3024 checked equal native/msolve bases on 378 systems. Per-target doubling/phi median elapsed ratios span 0.405438 to 5.524357, with no uniform advantage. Complete GAE prices and matched strongest rho remain open. This separate unscheduled scheduler specification remains draft; it is not a queued repeat.
question: Can adding (1-psi)(B) as physical factors increase independent index-calculus relations per completely counted unit without adding logarithm columns?
decision_value: An exact set and rank census distinguishes additional physical relation supply from duplicated automorphism images or dependent rows. A complete same-target collector comparison then decides whether the additional images and peel work improve cold index calculus. A loss retains the same controls and prevents promoting a larger base or an isolated relation count into a performance claim.

resources.notes: Executed manually through repository ephemeral runners with an 8 GiB address-space/1200-second per-case watchdog, one Rayon thread. Exact relation/rank counts have been audited on all 210 cases; cold timing has separate isolated five-round and A/A gates. Estimates remain null rather than infer cloud duration from arithmetic counts.
